text_block_list.text: (*Clang!*)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Hmm...? This is—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Lost property...? It's an unusual shape... 
First, I should report it to the General 
Affairs Committee.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Phew... report complete! With this, my 
duty is—... hm?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...? Is this the same part as before...?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Still, finding the same lost item twice in 
a row... Haha, as they say, third time's 
the—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ......Is there really?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...What's the deal here? Is the person who 
dropped this stuff just extremely clumsy, 
or—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yo!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
The culprit behind the bizarre serial 
lost-and-found dumping case has been 
APPREHEEENDED!!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh~. Meno-senpai is with Golshi-san 
again~.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Meno-cha...

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I mean, Senpai, whenever you're 
with Golshi-san, you totally give off 
'-chan' vibes♪

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Even if you're mad, you're not scary at 
all~. Actually, seeing us bicker like 
usual makes me happy! Kinda like that♪

“—Summer training camp starts today! The 
Umamusume will undergo intensive training 
at Tracen Academy's specialized facility.”

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa~~, Lady Gentil~! Tarumae-chan, do 
your best-!

In front of the school gate, a handful of 
fans had gathered to see the Umamusume 
off.

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Do your best, Fenomeno! I'm rooting for 
you!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Golshi's funny and all, but Meno... you're 
justice, right?! My dad and I are rootin' 
for you!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: O~h, my, my, my?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey boy, where's my cheer?

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, nope, won't do it! Golshi, you 
better run properly!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Pfft, don't you guys go playing contrarian 
on me now~. ...Right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Let's make this way more fun!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Wh—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I'm leaving you behind~ Mame-chin~

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Golshi-san! Why are you heading that 
way?! Your bus is Bus No. 10!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: No... How do you know about that...?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Because we're in the same class!!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Fufu... *giggle*... Ahaha...!

And so, watched over by their little fans, 
their summer training camp had begun!
